root_cause.text: In ath12k_mac_op_flush(), when called with vif == NULL (hardware-wide flush), the wiphy_work_flush() for the mgmt tx work is not called before waiting for pending transmissions, causing a deadlock because the wiphy lock is held by the flush process and the work cannot execute.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `wiphy_work_flush()` loop to before the `if (!vif)` block, ensuring it runs for all cases including vif == NULL. The CVE description and commit message explain the race: "Since wiphy lock has been taken by the flush process, the transmission work item has no chance to run, hence the dead lock."
